description: Get a company catalogue row, including name, UNP, industry and activity flag; includes inactive companies. Find company IDs with search_by_name. Example: {"uuid":"730f9a9e"}.

uuid.description: TokenBel id (usually 8 hex chars, no hyphens; not an RFC UUID). From search_by_name entity_type='company'.

name: company_get_by_uuid

uuid.description: TokenBel internal identifier: opaque hexadecimal string, usually 8 characters such as "78c7e502"; despite uuid field names, it is not an RFC UUID and normally has no hyphens.
